meta.title: Three bids: award a three-way split 4 / 3 / 3 to B, C and A; no approval flow
gaps: A closed RFQ with three bids from vendors A, B, and C at 100, 90, and 95 cannot be created or selected from the prepared one-bid state.
Splitting one line into quantities 4 for B, 3 for C, and 3 for A cannot be performed or asserted by the catalog.
The allocation amounts 360, 285, 300, and total 945 cannot be verified for the requested three vendors.
Submitting a proposal with the requested split and required proposal fields cannot be performed for this three-way allocation.
Creating and verifying one purchase order per awarded vendor cannot be performed for the requested split.
Verifying the event moves to History after the three-way award cannot be performed from the fixed prepared state.
